obligations: eval accepts one optional --in INPUT; omission preserves isolated evaluation and '-' reads stdin once
contextual eval compiles a paged document and evaluates against its introspector
selector.before and selector.after accept one selector boundary and named inclusive defaulting to true
the first boundary occurrence cuts document order; absent boundary preserves all base matches
repr, equality, hash and counter retain the complete selector tree
Before and After are rejected as show-rule selectors
